caption: The drawing depicts a single object centered on a plain, light background. The object is a flask with a teardrop shape and made to appear as a brownish-gold metallic container. At its top, there is a cylindrical cap and a dispenser, also depicted in a golden tone, with some markings or numbers visible on it. The flask features metal loops attached to either side near the top and bottom. The surface of the flask is decorated with a detailed relief design showing a standing male figure, possibly a classical hero, holding a spear and confronting a large coiled serpent or dragon. There are leafy plants at the base of the scene, and beneath the artwork, the words "JAMES DIXON & SONS" are inscribed. The drawing is signed with "B.R. Miller" in small, reddish letters close to the bottom right of the flask.
title: Powder Flask
